model_descriptions.Linear Regression: Fits a linear equation to the features. Fast to train and interpret, but struggles with non-linear relationships common in agricultural data.
model_descriptions.Decision Tree: Learns a tree of decision rules. Captures non-linear patterns. Single tree, easy to visualise and fast to evaluate.
model_descriptions.Random Forest: Ensemble of 100 decision trees. Robust to variance. Provides native feature importance. Slower to train.
model_descriptions.Gradient Boosting: Builds trees sequentially to correct the residual errors of preceding trees. Offers high accuracy with controlled tree depths.
model_descriptions.LightGBM: High-performance histogram-based gradient boosting. Uses leaf-wise growth to optimize complex non-linear feature interactions efficiently.
model_descriptions.XGBoost: State-of-the-art scalable gradient boosted trees with second-order gradient optimization and tree regularization for maximum generalization accuracy.

split_limitation: Rows from the same (Crop, State) pair may appear in both train and test sets. Performance may appear stronger than on fully unseen crops or states.
target: Yield (log1p transformed during training; expm1 for output)
